name: defective_return_pct
description: Share of defective returns among classified returns, and the count of classified returns

examples.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN SR_RETURN_REASON='defective' THEN 1 END)*100.0/ NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective','changed_mind') THEN 1 END),0),1) AS defective_pct FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.STORE_RETURNS WHERE SR_RETURNED_DATE >= '2026-04-01' AND SR_RETURNED_DATE < '2026-07-01'

exclusions: returns with other reasons are excluded from the denominator
definition.grain: aggregate over entire filtered date range
definition.population: Store returns with a reason of 'defective' or 'changed_mind'
definition.formula: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN SR_RETURN_REASON='defective' THEN 1 END)*100.0/ NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective','changed_mind') THEN 1 END),0),1) AS defective_pct, COUNT(CASE WHEN SR_RETURN_REASON IN ('defective','changed_mind') THEN 1 END) AS classified_returns FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.STORE_RETURNS WHERE SR_RETURNED_DATE >= '2026-04-01' AND SR_RETURNED_DATE < '2026-07-01'
